The two parties have mutually agreed and concluded to sell and buy the goods under the following terms
and conditions:

    I.        COMMODITY – PRICE – QUANTITY:

 No                   Model                  Quantity(MT)        Unit Price(USD)     Amount (USD)

In words: US Dollars Fifty One Thousand and One Hundered Only.

    II.       CONDITIONS:

 + Country of Origin: India
 + Quality: Stock Brand-new, as per given sample
 + Packing: To be packed suitably for standard export
   III.     DELIVERY TERMS:

 + Latest shipment date: 29 Apr 2024
 + Port of loading: Mundra Port, India
 + Port of discharge: Hai Phong Port, Vietnam
 + Partial shipment: Not Allowed
 + Transhipment: Not Allowed
   IV.      PAYMENT:
   Payment: 15 days da basis against acceptance

100% payment by irrevocable L/C.
       Bank            : HDFC Bank Ltd
       Bank's address : HDFC House, H T Parekh Marg, 165-166, Backbay Reclamation, Churchgate,
          Mumbai - 400 020.
       A/C No            50200048951419
       IFSC Code       : HDFC0003614
       Swift Code      : HDFCINBB
All following documents will be sent to the Buyer within 07 working days:
     Bill of Exchange/Draft Copy (1st Paid & 2nd Unpaid + 2nd Paid & 1st Unpaid)
     (3/3) original Ocean Clean on Board Bill of Lading, marked "Freight to collect".
     Signed Commercial Invoice: 03 originals
     Detailed Packing list: 03 originals
     Certificate of Quality and Quantity issued by The seller : 03 originals
     Certificate of Origin issued by India Chamber of Commerce: 1 original and 2 copies
     Weight Certificate issued by Independent Surveyor: 1 original and 2 copies
     Phytosanitary Certificate from GOVT.Agency: 1 original
     Radiation Certificate approved by Government: 1 original
     Fumigation Certificate from Competent Agency: 1 original and 2 copies
    V.      INSURANCE:

 To be coverd by the Seller, all risks covering 110% value of shipment in favor of the final Buyer claimable
 and payable in Vietnam.
   VI.     COMMON CLAUSE:

 This contract will be governed by the provision of “Incoterms 2010”.
 In the course of implementing this contract, all disputes not reaching at amicable agreement shall be
 settled by Economic Court in HaNoi Capital (Vietnam), whose awards shall be final and binding both
 parties. The law enforced the carrying out of the contract shall be Vietnamese Law.
    VII.     GENERAL CONDITIONS:

 If any change or amendment of this contract must be made in writing and appoved by both parties. This
 contract is made into 4 originals of the same value, 2 for the Buyer and 2 for the Seller and has the validity
 from the signing date lasting within 6 months.

       FOR THE SELLER                                                         FOR THE BUYER




                                                                                Nguyễn Thị Mai
